# A window's state is a top-level `var` in its body, which is where the checker
# leaves it: a component's `var` is collected into comp.Vars, a window's is
# not, and every platform reads it from the body.
#
# passContext promoted a window's body vars into Window.Vars, which nothing
# outside html's route mode reads. So declaring a context anywhere in the
# program -- not touching the window, not touching the var -- was enough to
# make the window's state vanish from bubbletea, fyne and gtk4. No error, no
# diagnostic: the element bound to it simply rendered empty.
#
# Each assertion is the initializer reaching the generated model. Both files
# declare the same window; only one of them declares a context.

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=bt-plain plain.sngl
grep 'alpha' bt-plain/model.go
sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=bt-ctx ctx.sngl
grep 'alpha' bt-ctx/model.go

sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=fy-plain plain.sngl
grep 'alpha' fy-plain/model.go
sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=fy-ctx ctx.sngl
grep 'alpha' fy-ctx/model.go

sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --out=gt-plain plain.sngl
grep 'alpha' gt-plain/model.go
sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --out=gt-ctx ctx.sngl
grep 'alpha' gt-ctx/model.go

sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=an-plain plain.sngl
grep 'alpha' an-plain/MainScreen.kt
sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=an-ctx ctx.sngl
grep 'alpha' an-ctx/MainScreen.kt

-- plain.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

window #home(title="Home", href="/") {
    var name = "alpha"
    vbox {
        text(value=name)
    }
}

-- ctx.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

context #theme("light")

window #home(title="Home", href="/") {
    var name = "alpha"
    vbox {
        text(value=name)
        text(value=theme)
    }
}
